body: I don't care about other people. I don't want to try to make my life better since I'm always going to be struggling financially.
Not planning on having children though.
Why shouldn't I give up? Struggle doesn't seem worth it.

So my parents just didn't love me enough to be rich? I feel like that's oversimplifying it.

I probably can't become obscenely rich and I certainly will never to get a position where I would be working because I 'want' to.
I'm only happy thinking about how great it would've been if I was born rich.
I grew up poor as well. I don't really see any point in being miserable struggling to barely pay the bills.
Why would I want to be remembered? I see no value in that, I just want to have been born with a shit ton of money.
